# crafty_server (Data Source)

Read an existing Crafty server by ID. Uses the servers visible to the configured token and performs no mutations.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "crafty_server" "existing" {
  id = "your-server-id"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Crafty server ID.

### Read-Only

- `auto_start` (Boolean) Current automatic start setting.
- `execution_command` (String) Current launch command.
- `monitoring_host` (String) Current monitoring address.
- `monitoring_port` (Number) Current monitoring port; distinct from server.properties.
- `name` (String) Current server name.
